identity: Silverleaf tends its saplings for centuries; a band of confused poachers is cutting them for this week.

quests.title: Tusks in the Undergrowth
quests.text: The Acorn Grunters tear up roots older than their whole bloodline, then charge anyone who objects. Cull six by day in the {name:foxglades}, which lie {zone_area:foxglades}. Patience is a virtue among trees, but against a charging boar it is mostly a way of being knocked over slowly.

variants.text: The {name:thornwood}, which lies {zone_area:thornwood}, has thorns enough without Bushpigs adding their tusks. Kill six there by day; they start the fight without asking, and Vine Asps hide in the same undergrowth. Wisdom is mostly noticing the second set of teeth.

The Plague Boars have been overturning the moor's soil with more enthusiasm than any gravedigger I have employed. Kill six by day out on the {name:blightmoor}, which spreads {zone_area:blightmoor}. They charge without an introduction, so leave yourself room to decline.

quests.lesson: Aggressive boars by day; the level-8 feet armor choice (one enchant).

quests.title: A Forest Is Not a Woodpile
quests.text: {name:misguided_poacher_chief} sees a week's firewood where we planted a century of shade. At the {name:poacher_camp}, {dir_from_giver:poacher_camp}, defeat seven Fern Poachers or Wood Thieves, and their chief. They hold the camp day and night; do not mistake a quiet axe for an empty watch.
quests.completion: Twig's axes have fallen quiet, and the trees have time again. You have helped preserve a shade you may never sit beneath. Wherever your path takes you, there will be room for you under ours.
quests.lesson: A camp pack plus a named leader; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).

quests.title: Beyond the First Ring
quests.text: Twig did not teach himself to turn our trees into profit. Follow the road to Starbough Village and tell Ilyra Mossveil what happened here; the cutters in her vale have had longer to practise. Attend to any unfinished business before you leave, and remember that a forest grows one ring at a time.
quests.lesson: Start to home handoff; leave at level 10.
